recurrence: P_i = a*C_i + b*P_(i-2) mod 29; two independent initial symbols K0,K1 at positions -2,-1.
grid: a,b in1..28 excluding four old pairs (1,1),(1,28),(28,1),(28,28); every 29^2 seed; 655980 recipes per page.
deduplication: Four sign pairs with arbitrary short seeds and no F skips already covered by E014; excluded. Period1 in E019 is a different delay.
algebra: For r=i mod d: S_r=0, q_r=1; S_i=C_i+b*S_(i-d), q_i=b*q_(i-d). P_i=a*S_i+q_i*x_r where x_r=P_r. Initial K_r=b^-1*(x_r-a*C_r), a bijection. This derivation works for d2 and d3; only d2 searched here.
period3_cost: 780*29^3=19023420 recipes/page, 29 times period2. Defer until measured period2 cost and validation are available; no exclusion of period3 claimed.
model: Frozen external4gram from E016; no LP training.
control_seeds: Random(3301025).randrange(29), two per listed case; exact top1 in all3 required before unknown scan.
unknown_scope: All55 unknown rune pages LP2-00..55 excluding numericLP2-50; no F skips, offset constant, alternate order or section continuation.
null: Select highest mean score; 19 independent exact count/doublet shuffles of selected page, full655980-recipe optimizer each time; plus-one p, Bonferroni55. If zero exceedances, larger preregistered follow-up required before significance claim.
memory: 2048 candidate rows at a time, at most1024 runes per page, int16 intermediates and dense29^4 score table; no full ensemble retained.
limits: Finite exploratory family extension with no historical coefficient clue. Synthetic controls are previously seen texts; neither controls nor high scores establish a historical solution. Any cost estimate for d3 is linear extrapolation, not a completed experiment.
